_comment: MA3 Analysis Tab Feedback Messages - Instructors can edit these
NAME_PRESENT: Your name is correctly entered in cell B10: {name}.
NAME_MISSING: Your name is missing from cell B10. Please enter your full name so the assignment can be identified as yours.
NAME_TOO_SHORT: The name in cell B10 appears too short: '{name}'. Please enter your full name.
DIFF_ALL_CORRECT: All 50 difference formulas in D14:D63 are correct. Each cell properly calculates the difference between the After and Before scores.
DIFF_ALL_CORRECT_ARRAY: Your difference calculations are correct using the array formula {formula}. This efficiently calculates all 50 differences at once.
DIFF_PARTIAL: {correct} out of 50 difference formulas are correct. Please review the cells listed below.
DIFF_NONE_CORRECT: None of the difference formulas in D14:D63 are correct. Each cell should contain a formula like =C14-B14 that subtracts the Before score from the After score.
DIFF_FORMULA_OK: Cell {cell} contains the correct difference formula.
DIFF_FORMULA_MISSING: Cell {cell} is missing a formula. It should contain =C{row}-B{row} to calculate the difference.
DIFF_FORMULA_WRONG: Cell {cell} contains an incorrect formula: '{found}'. It should be =C{row}-B{row} to calculate After minus Before.
DIFF_NOT_FORMULA: Cell {cell} contains a typed value instead of a formula. Please enter a formula that references the Before and After cells.
DIFF_ARRAY_WRONG: Cell {cell} contains an array formula '{found}' that is incorrect. The expected formula is =C14:C63-B14:B63.
STATS_ALL_CORRECT: All 12 statistics formulas are correct. Your Mean, Median, Standard Deviation, and Range calculations are properly set up.
STATS_PARTIAL: {correct} out of 12 statistics formulas are correct. Please review the issues noted below.
STATS_PARTIAL_CREDIT: {full_credit} out of 12 statistics formulas are fully correct, with {partial_credit} receiving partial credit. Your score is {score} out of {max_score}.
STATS_NONE_CORRECT: None of the statistics formulas are correct. Please use AVERAGE for mean, MEDIAN for median, STDEV for standard deviation, and MAX-MIN for range.
STAT_MEAN_OK: Your mean formula in {cell} is correct and uses the AVERAGE function with the proper range.
STAT_MEAN_WRONG: The mean formula in {cell} is incorrect. Please use the AVERAGE function to calculate the mean.
STAT_MEAN_MISSING: The mean formula in {cell} is missing. Please enter an AVERAGE function referencing the appropriate data range.
STAT_MEAN_PARTIAL: The mean formula in {cell} received partial credit: {hint}
STAT_MEDIAN_OK: Your median formula in {cell} is correct and uses the MEDIAN function with the proper range.
STAT_MEDIAN_WRONG: The median formula in {cell} is incorrect. Please use the MEDIAN function to calculate the median.
STAT_MEDIAN_MISSING: The median formula in {cell} is missing. Please enter a MEDIAN function referencing the appropriate data range.
STAT_MEDIAN_PARTIAL: The median formula in {cell} received partial credit: {hint}
STAT_STDEV_OK: Your standard deviation formula in {cell} is correct and uses the appropriate STDEV function.
STAT_STDEV_WRONG: The standard deviation formula in {cell} is incorrect. Please use STDEV, STDEV.P, or STDEV.S to calculate the standard deviation.
STAT_STDEV_MISSING: The standard deviation formula in {cell} is missing. Please enter a standard deviation function referencing the appropriate data range.
STAT_STDEV_PARTIAL: The standard deviation formula in {cell} received partial credit: {hint}
STAT_RANGE_OK: Your range formula in {cell} is correct and properly calculates MAX minus MIN.
STAT_RANGE_WRONG: The range formula in {cell} is incorrect. The range should be calculated as MAX minus MIN of the data.
STAT_RANGE_MISSING: The range formula in {cell} is missing. Please enter a formula that calculates MAX minus MIN.
STAT_RANGE_PARTIAL: The range formula in {cell} received partial credit: {hint}
PERCENTILE_ALL_CORRECT: Both percentile formulas are correct. Your 25th and 75th percentile calculations use the PERCENTILE function properly.
PERCENTILE_PARTIAL: {correct} out of 2 percentile formulas are correct. Please review the issues noted below.
PERCENTILE_NONE_CORRECT: Neither percentile formula is correct. Please use PERCENTILE, PERCENTILE.INC, or PERCENTILE.EXC with the difference data range (D14:D63).
PERCENTILE_OK: Your percentile formula in {cell} is correct.
PERCENTILE_WRONG: The percentile formula in {cell} is incorrect. {reason}
PERCENTILE_MISSING: The percentile formula in {cell} is missing. Please enter a PERCENTILE function with the appropriate range and percentile value.
EMPIRICAL_ALL_CORRECT: Both empirical rule formulas are correct. Your lower and upper bound calculations properly use the mean and standard deviation.
EMPIRICAL_PARTIAL: {correct} out of 2 empirical rule bounds are correct.
EMPIRICAL_NONE_CORRECT: Neither empirical rule formula is correct. The lower bound should be Mean minus Standard Deviation, and the upper bound should be Mean plus Standard Deviation.
EMPIRICAL_LOWER_OK: Your lower bound formula in {cell} is correct (Mean - Standard Deviation).
EMPIRICAL_LOWER_WRONG: The lower bound formula in {cell} is incorrect. It should calculate Mean minus Standard Deviation (=I18-I20 or equivalent).
EMPIRICAL_LOWER_MISSING: The lower bound formula in {cell} is missing. Please enter a formula that calculates Mean minus Standard Deviation.
EMPIRICAL_UPPER_OK: Your upper bound formula in {cell} is correct (Mean + Standard Deviation).
EMPIRICAL_UPPER_WRONG: The upper bound formula in {cell} is incorrect. It should calculate Mean plus Standard Deviation (=I18+I20 or equivalent).
EMPIRICAL_UPPER_MISSING: The upper bound formula in {cell} is missing. Please enter a formula that calculates Mean plus Standard Deviation.
WRITTEN_MISSING: The written analysis for section 5b is missing. Please provide your interpretation of the results.
WRITTEN_TOO_SHORT: Your written analysis appears brief ({length} characters). Please ensure you have fully addressed the question.
FORMAT_ALL_CORRECT: All cells on the Analysis tab are formatted correctly.
FORMAT_PARTIAL: {correct} out of {total} cells are formatted correctly. Please review the formatting issues noted below.
FORMAT_CELL_WRONG: Cell {cell} should be formatted as Number with 2 decimal places.
